instructions: Two specs are changing at once. Compare the first changed clause with the second, each from a different spec. Choose contradicts when both cannot hold together. Choose first oversteps second when the first clause takes on a behavior or responsibility the second clause assigns to its own spec or bounds, without contradicting it; choose second oversteps first for the reverse. Choose overlaps when both describe the same behavior or surface without conflict or overstep. Choose unrelated when they share no behavior or boundary that needs a review flag. Do not flag a merely related clause.

labels.name: contradicts
labels.description: The two clauses cannot both hold.

input.first: Invoices are sent on the first day of each month.
input.second: Invoices are sent on the last day of each month.

input.first: Guests may post comments without an account.
input.second: Only signed-in members can post comments.

labels.name: first oversteps second
labels.description: The first clause takes on a behavior or responsibility the second clause bounds or assigns to its own spec, without contradicting it.

input.first: The checkout page also recalculates warehouse stock levels.
input.second: The inventory service alone owns warehouse stock levels.

input.first: The mobile app stores payment card numbers for reuse.
input.second: The payments vault is the only place card numbers are kept.

labels.name: second oversteps first
labels.description: The second clause takes on a behavior or responsibility the first clause bounds or assigns to its own spec, without contradicting it.

input.first: The notification service alone decides when emails are sent.
input.second: The signup form sends its own welcome email right away.

input.first: Search ranking is owned by the ranking module only.
input.second: The product page reorders search results by margin.

labels.name: overlaps
labels.description: Both clauses describe the same behavior or surface without conflict or overstep.

input.first: Receipts list each purchased item with its price.
input.second: A receipt shows every item bought and what it cost.

input.first: Password resets expire after one hour.
input.second: A reset link stops working sixty minutes after it is sent.

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: The clauses share no behavior or boundary that needs a review flag.

input.first: The dashboard header shows the team name.
input.second: Exported reports use the ISO date format.

input.first: Uploaded photos are resized to fit the gallery.
input.second: Support tickets close after thirty days of silence.
